variants.after: Down in the gaslit streets, you catch a glimpse of the runners circulating a rough charcoal sketch of your own face, ensuring every passing watchman knows exactly who to look for in the gloom.
The frantic pace of the guards beneath the ridge tells you they have already discovered the forced lock on the undervault, turning a quiet manhunt into a desperate scramble for the broken seal.

Far below, a sergeant barks orders peppered with specific details about your solitary flight, a bitter reminder that the terrified deacon you spared has already poured his tale into the ears of the Guard.

Your rough porter's livery provides a momentary shield in the shadows, making you look like nothing more than an overworked labourer trying to clear a jammed coal chute if any passing patrol happens to glance down the narrow alleyway.
Blood from the deacon you pushed to his death still rusts upon your sleeves, a grim guarantee that any echoing mistake you make at this lock will lead straight to the hangman's noose.
An unnatural draft whistles down from the grandmaster's lock you just destroyed, warning you that the breached doorway left yawning open behind you gives the surface watch a perfect trail to follow.
